result.note: Tests the India–Russia naval exercise INDRA 2026: the ship, the venue, the sequence of phases and the summit link.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Exercise INDRA 2026, held in October 2026:
items: The Indian Navy was represented by INS Sahyadri, which arrived at Vladivostok for the exercise.
The exercise was to open with coordinated operations at sea before moving to harbour engagements.
The Ministry of Defence linked the deployment to the India–Russia annual summit held in December 2025.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The second statement is wrong because the exercise began with harbour engagements and then moved to coordinated operations at sea. INS Sahyadri reached Vladivostok on 10 October 2026 for the drills, scheduled for 13 to 18 October, and the Ministry of Defence said the deployment followed the December 2025 annual summit.
questions.source: The India–Russia naval exercise will begin with harbour engagements before moving to coordinated operations at sea.
